title: What should you ask first in a competitive response case, and which trap should you avoid?
description: The first question to ask in a competitive response case, how to structure it, and the trap to avoid.
hook: When a rival makes a move, the client wants to know how to respond. Here is how to keep your head and give a balanced answer.
body:
The first question to ask

How big is the threat in revenue terms?

How to build your structure

  • Exposure (customers, revenue and margin at risk)
  • Rival's motive (segments targeted, can they keep it up)
  • Options (do nothing, defend current customers, respond on price or product, partner or buy)
  • Choose on impact, cost, speed and risk vs doing nothing

The trap most people fall into

Not comparing to doing nothing.

For the full tree, with every branch, read the competitive response framework.
